title: CRISPR-based RNA proximity proteomics (CBRPP)
author: Yunfei Li
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bfjtjknn

steps.title: Generate rtTA‑expressing HEK293T cells
steps.instruction: Infect ~50% confluent HEK293T cells with lentivirus carrying pLVX‑TetO3G(rtTA)-hygr vector for 48 h; select with 50 µg ml⁻¹ hygromycin in growth medium for 7 days; pick hygromycin‑resistant clones, test rtTA expression by immunoblotting, expand and store the best clone.

steps.title: Create doxycycline‑inducible dPspCas13b‑BioID2 line
steps.instruction: Infect the selected rtTA‑positive clone with lentivirus bearing the Inducible‑dPspCas13b‑BioID2 plasmid for 48 h; select with 1 µg ml⁻¹ puromycin for 7 days; harvest puromycin‑resistant clones by limiting dilution, pick individual clones, expand and screen by immunoblotting for doxycycline‑inducible dPspCas13b‑BioID2 expression; expand, retest and store the desired clones.

steps.title: Design crRNA plasmids
steps.instruction: Design crRNA sequences targeting multiple regions of the endogenous RNA of interest as well as non‑targeting control crRNAs, and clone them into the appropriate expression plasmid.

steps.title: Validate crRNA efficacy
steps.instruction: Test each crRNA by either knockdown using active PspCas13b or by RIP‑qPCR with dPspCas13b‑BioID2; select the optimal crRNAs for downstream experiments.

steps.title: Plate and transfect cells
steps.instruction: Plate inducible dPspCas13b‑BioID2 HEK293T cells in 10 cm dishes at 70 % confluency 18 h before transfection; transfect each dish with 20 µg crRNA plasmid (targeting or non‑targeting).

steps.title: Induce expression and add biotin
steps.instruction: Six hours post‑transfection replace medium with fresh growth medium containing 0.1 µg ml⁻¹ doxycycline; after an additional 15 h add biotin to a final concentration of 50 µM; continue incubation for 18 h of biotin labeling.

steps.title: Harvest and freeze cell pellets
steps.instruction: Remove medium, wash cells three times with ice‑cold PBS, scrape cells into ice‑cold PBS, transfer to 1.5 ml tubes, centrifuge at 3600 rpm for 5 min, flash‑freeze pellets in liquid nitrogen and store at –80 °C.

steps.title: Lyse cells in RIPA buffer
steps.instruction: Resuspend each frozen pellet in RIPA lysis buffer (50 mM Tris, 150 mM NaCl, 0.1 % SDS, 0.5 % sodium deoxycholate, 1 % Triton X‑100, protease cocktail [TargetMol], 1 mM PMSF) on ice and incubate at 4 °C for 10 min.

steps.title: Clarify lysate and reserve sample
steps.instruction: Centrifuge lysates at 12 000 g for 10 min at 4 °C; transfer supernatant to a new tube, set aside 50 µl for western‑blot detection of biotinylation, keep remainder for pull‑down.

steps.title: Bind biotinylated proteins to streptavidin beads
steps.instruction: Wash streptavidin magnetic beads twice with RIPA buffer; add beads to the lysate supernatant and rotate overnight at 4 °C.

steps.title: Wash bead‑bound proteins
steps.instruction: Day 2: wash beads twice with 1 ml RIPA buffer, once with 1 ml 1 M KCl, once with 1 ml 0.1 M Na₂CO₃, once with 1 ml 2 M urea in 10 mM Tris‑HCl (pH 8.0), and twice more with 1 ml RIPA buffer.

steps.title: Elute and prepare for mass spectrometry
steps.instruction: Boil beads in 150 µl elution buffer (55 mM Tris‑HCl pH 8.0, 0.1 % SDS, 6.66 mM DTT, 0.66 mM biotin) for 10 min; collect eluate and submit for mass‑spectrometry analysis.
